name: rbe2
notes: Nastran independent node GN is mapped to OpenRadioss /RBE2 node_ID.
Nastran component CM is mapped to OpenRadioss Trarot.
Nastran dependent nodes GM are represented by /GRNOD/NODE.
The /RBE2 grnd_ID references the generated dependent-node group.
The /GRNOD/NODE and /RBE2 records are emitted as separate Blocks.
